# External Fixture Attribution

This project uses example fixtures from the following MIT-licensed projects for cross-validation testing. These fixtures are not distributed with peelbox — they are fetched on demand via `scripts/fetch-compat-fixtures.sh`.

## Railpack

- **Repository**: https://github.com/railwayapp/railpack
- **License**: MIT
- **Usage**: Example projects from `examples/` directory used as test fixtures
- **Commit**: Pinned in `compat-sources.toml`

## Nixpacks

- **Repository**: https://github.com/railwayapp/nixpacks
- **License**: MIT
- **Usage**: Example projects from `examples/` directory used as test fixtures
- **Commit**: Pinned in `compat-sources.toml`
